architecture: Keep entry-point/CLI parsing separate from reusable functions.
Validate paths, arguments, dependencies, and configuration before side effects.
Write a clear success and failure status; keep data output separate from diagnostics.
Test in an isolated temporary fixture and check the expected result.
test_plan: Test a normal input and the empty/missing-input path.
Test a filename or value containing whitespace.
Force one dependency/command failure and confirm a nonzero status.
Repeat execution to verify idempotence or intended behavior.
Review with bash -n and ShellCheck; use Bats if installed.
